cleared_risks.description: The repo has three files, and src/lib.rs only declares `pub mod table;`. No importers of src/table.rs were found, identifier search for A0 matched only its own definition, and the reference lookup on A0's symbol returned nothing. I found no in-repo caller that depends on the old values, so the hypothesis has no causal path here. External consumers of this public crate would be outside what I could check.
cleared_risks.name: Global +1 shift of table constants breaks value-dependent callers

risk_level.reason: A single-file mechanical shift of every constant value in a lookup table; the change is simple but any consumer relying on the old numeric values, or an off-by-one in the table, could cause silent defects.
